description: Configuration header for LittleFS adapted for Zephyr, including utility functions, logging macros, and system includes.

methods.name: lfs_max
methods.description: Returns the maximum of two uint32_t values.

methods.name: lfs_min
methods.description: Returns the minimum of two uint32_t values.

methods.name: lfs_aligndown
methods.description: Aligns a value down to the nearest multiple of the specified alignment.

methods.name: lfs_alignup
methods.description: Aligns a value up to the nearest multiple of the specified alignment.

methods.name: lfs_npw2
methods.description: Finds the smallest power of two greater than or equal to a.

methods.name: lfs_ctz
methods.description: Counts trailing zeros in a uint32_t.

methods.name: lfs_popc
methods.description: Counts the number of set bits in a uint32_t.

methods.name: lfs_fromle32
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit little-endian value to native order.

methods.name: lfs_tole32
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit value from native to little-endian order.

methods.name: lfs_frombe32
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit big-endian value to native order.

methods.name: lfs_tobe32
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit value from native to big-endian order.

methods.name: lfs_malloc
methods.description: Allocates memory, fallback to NULL if disabled.
